description: FALCON is Idaho National Laboratory's finite-element model of coupled geothermal reservoir behaviour. Built on the MOOSE framework, it solves fluid flow, heat transfer, rock deformation and fracturing, and chemical reactions in porous geology. Inputs describe geology, fluid properties, boundary conditions and operating scenarios; outputs are simulated thermal, hydraulic, mechanical and chemical states. The modelled site, mesh and period are set by the user. Source is free under LGPL-2.1, with installation information linked from the repository. A limitation is that the short README does not describe a ready-to-run data package; a usable reservoir study requires site-specific properties and a compatible MOOSE build. The cited Utah FORGE native-state application is an evidence lead, not a validation of every configuration. FALCON can help assess geothermal wells and heat infrastructure. It is distinct from regional groundwater-recharge models. No model build or Utah FORGE data retrieval was attempted.
